Class AutoCloseables

java.lang.Object
org.apache.commons.lang3.AutoCloseables
public class AutoCloseables extends Object
Static operations on AutoCloseable.

For Closeable-specific methods, see Apache Commons IO's IOUtils.

Since:
3.21.0

    • closeQuietly

      public static void closeQuietly(AutoCloseable closeable)
      Closes an AutoCloseable, never throwing an Exception.

      Equivalent to AutoCloseable.close(), except any exceptions will be ignored.

      Parameters:
      closeable - The objects to close, may be null or already closed.
      See Also:
      • Throwable.addSuppressed(Throwable)

    • closeQuietly

      public static void closeQuietly(Iterable<AutoCloseable> closeables)
      Closes an iterable of AutoCloseable, never throwing an Exception.

      Equivalent calling AutoCloseable.close() on each element, except any exceptions will be ignored.

      Parameters:
      closeables - The objects to close, may be null or already closed.
      See Also:
      • closeQuietly(AutoCloseable)

    • closeQuietlySuppress

      public static <T extends Throwable> T closeQuietlySuppress(Closeable closeable, T throwable)
      Closes a Closeable unconditionally and adds any exception thrown by the close() to the given Throwable.

      For example: 

      AutoCloseable autoCloseable = ...;
try {
    // process autoCloseable.
} catch (Exception e) {
    // Handle exception.
    throw AutoCloseables.closeQuietlySuppress(autoCloseable, e);
}

      Also consider using a try-with-resources statement where appropriate.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The Throwable type.
      Parameters:
      closeable - The object to close, may be null or already closed.
      throwable - Add the exception throw by the closeable to the given Throwable.
      Returns:
      The given Throwable.
      See Also:
      • Throwable.addSuppressed(Throwable)
